equity.level_reason: Contrasts are by country income group and FCV status, which the brief excludes as SPDs (a country's income group is geography); age only defines the coverage population.

level_alternative.reason: The article frames lower coverage and higher incidence in low-income and FCV countries as inequities and quantifies them (more than 10 times), which would be a quantified, interpreted disparity if country income were read as SES.

ev.q: Calculated for MCV1, among children aged 1 year or, if MCV1 is given at age ≥1 year, among children aged 24 months.

equity.equity_measurement: Comparisons are across countries grouped by World Bank income group and FCV-setting status, not by social position of persons; IA2030 'equitable 95% coverage' is a general program target.

notes: Case fatality ratios come from the external measlesCFR package (a covariate model fitted to a systematic review), treated as a cited input rather than the article's own procedure. WUENIC coverage estimates are external WHO/UNICEF estimates. Design inferred as monitoring progress against elimination and coverage targets.
